Example: Position Size calculation

Using these inputs:

  • Asset class: Stocks
  • Account balance: $10,000
  • Risk as: % of balance
  • Risk per trade: 1%
  • Entry price: 50
  • Stop-loss price: 48
  • Take-profit (optional): 56
  • Fee per side: 0%
  • Round down to whole shares / contracts: Yes

The calculator returns:

  • Position size: 50 shares (Long position)
  • Position value: $2,500
  • Amount at risk: $100.00 (1% of account)
  • Stop distance: 4% ($2.00)
  • Leverage needed: None (0.25× notional / balance)
  • Reward : risk: 3 : 1
  • Profit at target: $300.00
